name: Adapted Radiosity for Gaussian Surfels
definition: A forward rendering technique that solves the rendering equation for Gaussian surfels (kernels) by assuming constant emission and BRDF within each kernel, and constant outgoing radiance within a kernel to derive a weighted residual solution.
summary: Adapted Radiosity for Gaussian Surfels is a forward rendering technique using explicit Gaussian surfels to solve the rendering equation, differing from Neural Radiosity by avoiding single neural networks for efficient direct illumination and geometry reconstruction.
